'''''Mycobacterium mageritense''''' is a species of rapidly growing [[microorganism]] in the genus [[Mycobacterium]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Muñoz-Sanz |first=Agustín |last2=Rodríguez-Vidigal |first2=Francisco F. |last3=Vera-Tomé |first3=Araceli |last4=Jiménez |first4=María Soledad |date=2013-01-01 |title=Mycobacterium mageritense meningitis in an immunocompetent patient with an intrathecal catheter |url=https://www.elsevier.es/es-revista-enfermedades-infecciosas-microbiologia-clinica-28-articulo-mycobacterium-mageritense-meningitis-in-an-S0213005X12002042 |journal=Enfermedades Infecciosas y Microbiología Clínica |language=es |volume=31 |issue=1 |pages=59–60 |doi=10.1016/j.eimc.2012.05.007 |issn=0213-005X|url-access=subscription }}</ref> This species causes [[Lymphadenopathy|Lymphadentis]] in children. In adults, '''M. mageritense''' causes [[pneumonia]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last=García-Boyano |first=Miguel |last2=Baquero-Artigao |first2=Fernando |last3=Toro |first3=Carlos |last4=Alguacil-Guillén |first4=Marina |last5=Lázaro-Perona |first5=Fernando |last6=Calvo |first6=Cristina |title=Mycobacterium mageritense Lymphadenitis in Child - Volume 28, Number 3—March 2022 - Emerging Infectious Diseases journal - CDC |url=https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/28/3/21-1486_article |language=en-us |doi=10.3201/eid2803.211486|doi-access=free |pmc=8888222 }}</ref>

== Etymology ==
Magerit, is [[Arabic]] for [[Madrid]], where it was first isolated from human [[sputum]].

==Description==
This species is a gram-positive, nonmotile and strongly acid-fast rods.

=== Colony characteristics ===
Their colonies are smooth, mucoid and [[nonphotochromogenic]] colonies.

=== Physiology ===
Members of this species have rapid growth on [[Löwenstein-Jensen]] medium at 22 °C, 30 °C, 37 °C and 45 °C within 2–4 days. Their optimum growth at 30 °C and 37 °C. M. mageritense is resistant to [[isoniazid]], [[cycloserine]], [[capreomycin]], [[pyrazinamide]], and [[thiosemicarbazone]]. Most strains are also resistant to [[ethambutol]].

=== Differential characteristics ===
This species can be characterized by unique hsp65 gene, 16S rDNA and sodA sequences. They are closely related to ''M. fortuitum'' and ''M. peregrinum'' at the DNA homology level. They can also be differentiation from ''M. fortuitum'' by its growth at 45 °C and by its use of mannitol as a sole carbon source.

==Pathogenesis==
It has a [[Biosafety level]] 1.

==Type strain==
Mycobacterium mageritense was first isolated from a [[human]] ([[Human|Homo spaien]]) [[sputum]] in [[Madrid]].

Strain 938 = ATCC 700351 = CCUG 37984 = CIP 104973 = DSM 44476 = JCM 12375.
